d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne karnatak ko 15 hajar 600 karor rupye ki vibhinn vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat di. is dauran pradhanmantri ne bengluru metro ki pink lain ki shuruaat ki aur metro men saphar bhi kiya. in pariyojnaon se rajy men shahri parivhan aur aadharbhut suvidhaon ko majbuti milne ki ummid hai. vahin, lok aastha ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath ki shuruaat nahay-khay ke sath huee. pahle din shraddhaluon ne paranpra ke anusar snan kar vishesh aahar grahan kiya. chhathavrati kal kharna ka anushthan karenge, jiske bad 36 ghante ke nirjala vrat ki shuruaat hogi. is avsar par kaee…
